segments.en: [This letter opens mid-sentence in the source text.]

…Who is the source of the vitality and the existence of Israel (and) the world. And even one who has descended as he has descended — and has strayed (as he has strayed) in his desires and his character traits as he has strayed — Heaven forbid. There is no corrupted or blemished or sinning one in the world — who will not find hope and repair forever — through drawing close to the true Tzadik in the truly true truth. Love love love — aleph.
